Escriba la dirección del servidor EH3D-S: Type the address of the EH3D-SERVER (the one of your network, for example the CM5's) and port 18200, and press Connect. If the server has no users yet, the app asks for the set-up code shown on its console and creates the first administrator. Then sign in.
La pantalla Máquinas muestra cada máquin: The Machines screen shows each machine of the workshop: free, working or waiting for the operator, with the progress of the job and what is left. Tap a machine to follow it in real time.
El botón rojo para la máquina: se cancel: The red button stops the machine: its job is cancelled and the spindle and the motors switch off. It asks for a second press to avoid accidental stops. Only operators and administrators can stop it; other users only watch. It does not replace the physical emergency button of the machine.
Muestra la placa, los agujeros (un anill: It shows the board, the holes (a ring until they are drilled, filled after) and the paths (dim until they are cut). The green ring marks where the head is; it is an estimate from the steps done that the server reports. In 3D, drag to turn and tap twice to go back.
Si la máquina tiene un nodo de cabezal (: If the machine has a head node (EH3D-NODE-BUNGARD-AUX) you will see its camera, the turns and the temperature of the spindle and the protect output, and you can measure the height of the table with the laser.
La pestaña Trabajos lista los trabajos d: The Jobs tab lists the jobs of the server. A job never starts by itself: open it and press Start with the machine ready. When the machine asks for a tool change, confirm from here.
